title: Implement layered and atomic skill override storage
objective: Persist user/project overrides and expose session overlays without mixing policy scopes or weakening managed settings.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid design: an initial developer-role catalog snapshot, append-only upsert/revoke deltas, on-demand SKILL.md bodies, and an authoritative execution registry.
The repository is a dirty shared worktree. Preserve unrelated changes and modify only owned_files.

source_evidence.note: Codex uses a bounded initial metadata catalog and loads full SKILL.md on demand.
Claude Code supports live skill discovery, visibility overrides, and on-demand skill bodies.
Append-only conversation messages preserve the previously cached prompt prefix.

include: Read and merge user, project-local, managed, and session override layers.
Write persistent changes atomically to the intended settings scope.
Persist last_non_off with off overrides so a binary toggle survives menu close, process restart, and text-command mutations.
Expose revision-checked project override writes plus a compensating restore primitive for Manager-owned persist-and-live transactions.
Support set, reset-to-inherited, and effective source reporting.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Define an OverrideStore interface and file-backed implementation.
Add temp-directory tests for precedence, atomic replace, corruption handling, and reset.
Keep session overlay storage injectable and race-safe.
acceptance_criteria: Persistent overrides survive a fresh store instance.
Last non-off visibility survives a fresh store instance and is updated by both direct set and toggle operations.
A stale expected revision cannot overwrite a newer stable-ID override.
Session overrides do not leak between sessions.
Failed writes preserve the previous valid settings file.
risks: Settings paths must reuse existing brand/config conventions rather than inventing a fourth configuration tree.
dispatch_prompt: Implement layered atomic skill override storage in new skills files with temp-dir tests. Do not edit commands/config.go or settings validators.
notes_for_assignee: Keep the diff narrow; if a dependency contract is insufficient, report the required change to the integrator instead of editing another task's files.
